text: In the Alps of fifteenth-century Austria, the girl Albrun lives with her goat-herding mother in a remote cottage where [men in goat skins bang on the door crying witch|threat|the group turns on you]. Fifteen years after her mother's death, Albrun herds goats alone with her infant daughter, [shunned and harassed in town|wrong|the outsider punished], and keeps [her mother's flower-painted skull|images|corpses and body parts] by a candle in the corner. Voices call from the woods, a neighbour's friendship turns to betrayal, and Albrun carries [a dead rat to the village water|wants|revenge for a wrong].
